title: 第005章 同门途中遭旧疾少女施音愈顽伤第006章 众人登门求诊治少女深夜戒凶徒
content_zh:
半个时辰转瞬即逝。
蔡文姬背着简单的行囊，和另外七名新晋弟子汇合，跟着两名清风宗修士，踏上了前往青螺山的山路。
山路蜿蜒崎岖，林木葱郁，山间灵气远比山下浓郁。
另外几名新弟子一路东张西望，兴奋不已，唯有蔡文龙时不时用阴恻恻的眼神瞟向蔡文姬，敌意毫不掩饰。
行至半山腰，同行的一名外门弟子忽然脚步踉跄，捂住胸口闷哼一声，脸色瞬间惨白。
“糟了！旧伤复发了！”
矮个修士脸色一变。这位师兄早年外出历练，被妖兽所伤，胸腔留下顽疾。
平日里压制得住，可今日长途跋涉，灵气运转不畅，旧伤直接爆发。
他蜷缩在路边，额头上冷汗直流，气息紊乱，体内灵气四处冲撞，痛苦不堪。
两名同伴连忙上前相助，运转自身灵气试图帮他梳理伤势，可几番尝试下来，不仅毫无效果，反而让对方的伤势越发严重。
“不行！他这是经脉淤塞，寻常灵气根本化解不了，再拖延下去，怕是会伤及根本！”
李师兄急得满头大汗。
几名新晋弟子吓得连连后退，手足无措。
蔡文龙缩在人群后方，暗自庆幸，半点上前帮忙的意思都没有。
就在众人束手无策之际，一道轻柔的身影缓步走上前。
“让我试试吧。”
蔡文姬放下行囊，目光落在痛苦呻吟的修士身上。
众人皆是一愣，随即面露怀疑。
一个刚入门的新人，还是个古怪的音律灵根，连基础吐纳都未必学会，能治好多年顽疾？
李师兄本想拒绝，可眼下别无他法，只能无奈侧身：“你小心些。”

蔡文姬微微颔首，不再迟疑，心念一动，全力催动一技能【思无邪】。
温润如水的音律灵气自她体内流淌而出，化作淡淡的音波笼罩全场。
柔和的力量缓缓渗入那名受伤修士的经脉与五脏六腑，如同春风化雨，一点点抚平紊乱的灵气，疏通淤塞的经脉，修复受损的肌理。
原本撕心裂肺的痛苦飞速消退，翻腾的内息渐渐平稳，额头上的冷汗慢慢收干。
不过数息功夫，方才还奄奄一息的修士长长吐出一口气，缓缓站起身，脸上满是不可思议。
“不疼了！经脉也通顺了！多年的暗伤……居然缓解了大半！”
全场死寂。
两名清风宗修士目瞪口呆，新晋弟子们更是惊掉了下巴。
就这么简单？一曲无形音波，治好了连同门都束手无策的陈年旧伤？
蔡文龙站在人群里，脸色一阵青一阵白，心底的嫉妒几乎要溢出来。
而两名带队修士看向蔡文姬的目光，已然变成了十足的珍视。
捡到宝了！这哪里是普通的新弟子，分明是宗门挖到的一尊移动“活药王”！
蔡文姬收回力量，拍了拍小手，歪着脑袋一笑。
小场面而已。
想当年在峡谷，残血五杀、极限抬血都是家常便饭，区区旧伤，洒洒水啦。
content_en:
Half an hour flies by.
Carrying a simple bag, Cai Wenji met up with seven other new disciples and followed two Qingfeng Sect monks on the mountain road to Qingluo Mountain.
The mountain roads are winding and rugged, the trees are lush, and the spiritual energy in the mountains is far richer than below.
Several other new disciples looked around, excited, but Cai Wenlong glanced at Cai Wenji with sinister eyes from time to time, showing no concealment of hostility.
Halfway up the mountain, an outer disciple who was traveling with him suddenly staggered, clutched his chest and groaned, his face instantly turned pale.
"Oops! The old injury has recurred!"
The short monk's expression changed. This senior brother went out for training in his early years and was injured by a monster, leaving a stubborn disease in his chest.
Normally I can suppress it, but today I traveled a long distance and my spiritual energy was not flowing smoothly, and my old injuries directly broke out.
He was huddled on the side of the road, cold sweat dripping from his forehead, his breath was disordered, and the spiritual energy in his body was rushing around, causing him great pain.
The two companions hurriedly stepped forward to help, using their spiritual energy to try to help him sort out his injuries. However, after several attempts, not only did they have no effect, but they made the other party's injuries more serious.
"No! His meridians are blocked, and ordinary spiritual energy can't resolve it. If he delays it any longer, I'm afraid it will damage his roots!"
Senior Brother Li was so anxious that he was sweating profusely.
Several new disciples were so frightened that they backed away and were at a loss.
Cai Wenlong huddled behind the crowd, secretly thankful, and had no intention of stepping forward to help.
Just when everyone was helpless, a gentle figure walked forward slowly.
"Let me try."
Cai Wenji put down her luggage and looked at the monk groaning in pain.
Everyone was stunned for a moment, and then looked suspicious.
How can a newcomer, who has a weird musical talent and may not even know the basics of breath and breathing, be able to cure a long-standing illness?
Senior Brother Li wanted to refuse, but at the moment he had no other choice but to turn sideways: "Be careful."
Cai Wenji nodded slightly, no longer hesitated, and with a thought, she activated the skill [Siwuxie] with all her strength.
The warm and watery musical aura flowed out of her body and turned into a faint sound wave that enveloped the entire audience.
The gentle power slowly penetrated into the meridians and internal organs of the injured monk, like spring breeze turning into rain, gradually smoothing out the disordered spiritual energy, unblocking the blocked meridians, and repairing the damaged texture.
The heart-rending pain subsided quickly, the churning inner breath gradually stabilized, and the cold sweat on his forehead slowly dried up.
After a few breaths, the monk who was still dying just took out a long breath and stood up slowly, with a look of disbelief on his face.
"It doesn't hurt anymore! The meridians are also smooth! Years of hidden injuries...are actually relieved by most of them!"
The whole place was dead silent.
The two Qingfeng Sect monks were stunned, and the new disciples were even more shocked.
Is it that simple? An invisible sound wave healed the old wounds that even the whole family was helpless to do?
Cai Wenlong stood in the crowd, his face turning green and white, and the jealousy in his heart almost overflowed.
The two leading monks looked at Cai Wenji with full respect.
Found a treasure! This is not an ordinary new disciple, it is clearly a mobile "Living Medicine King" dug up by the sect!
Cai Wenji took back her strength, clapped her little hands, tilted her head and smiled.
Just a small scene.
I think back then in the canyon, five kills with residual health and extreme blood lifting were commonplace, and only old injuries were sprinkled with water.
